verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Namecheap claiming at-cost or wholesale pricing, publishing registry fee breakdowns, or offering a low-margin guarantee. The only pricing-related items are a reseller-program FAQ title and a community note that renewals are charged at full price; neither shows wholesale pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee
